summary: Family→corpus coverage audit — flag missing religions/corpora + propose adds from existing vault docs

result.summary: Six regional goblins surfaced 47 distinct corpus gaps spanning Israelite/Canaanite/Hurro-Hittite ancient Near Eastern strata, the entire Christian post-NT spine (Patristic, Byzantine, Latin Catholic, Syriac, Apostolic Fathers, Apocrypha, Theosophy, Marcionite), six major Islamic sub-traditions (Ismaili, Ishraqi, School of Isfahan, Tafsir, Arabic Neoplatonism, South Asian Sufi reform, Islamism), eight Indic/East-Asian splits (Vaishnava/Shaiva/Shakta/Advaita/Sant/Zen-Soto/Engishiki/Jataka), nine Indigenous/oral traditions (Yoruba-Ifa, Vodou-Lucumi, Andean, Aztec/Maya split, Polynesian, Indigenous N.A., Dreaming), and nine modern/heterodox (Neoplatonist, Theosophy, Thelema, Wicca, Scientology, LaVeyan Satanism, Mystery Cults, New Thought). The biggest miss is the Christian post-NT canon: Patristic, Byzantine, and Latin Catholic medieval together orphan ~33 vault docs of arguably the most civilizationally weighty tradition in the West — a glaring structural hole. The Israelite-pre-exilic + Canaanite-Ugaritic + Hurro-Hittite ancient-NE trio directly serves John's MASSIVE-WINS criterion and includes one real reclassification (Baal Cycle is currently mis-filed under mesopotamian). Nearly all the proposed adds have ready vault docs (only Marcionite canon needs net-new content). Recommendation: ship as Lane B canon-audit Phase B with ~42 corpora additions and 8 reclassifications; defer only the Marcionite gap to Lane A.

high_priority_adds.rationale: John's flagged seed example. Pre-exilic Israelite religion (J/E/D/P, Deuteronomistic History, Kuntillet Ajrud) is documentarily distinct from post-exilic Tanakh/Bible. 8 vault docs ready. MASSIVE-WIN tier — opens YHWH-Asherah, divine council, source-critical strata as a religion of origin.

Baal Cycle is currently mis-classified under mesopotamian — Canaanite is West Semitic, not Mesopotamian. Reclassification + corpus creation in one move. Largest cross-tradition bridge (El/Baal/Asherah/Anat/Mot/Yam → YHWH absorption).
Kumarbi succession-myth is the structural ancestor of Hesiod's Theogony. Illuyanka is the chaoskampf prototype. 3 vault docs ready, all currently orphaned.

Largest orphan cluster in the vault — 16 docs (Irenaeus through Leo's Tome) defining Trinitarian + Christological orthodoxy, currently homeless. Migne PG/PL is the canonical corpus. This is the single biggest content win.
Post-patristic Byzantine spine (Dionysius → Maximus → John of Damascus → Palamas + Cloud of Unknowing + Eriugena). 7 orphan docs. The Orthodox systematic canon parallel to Catholic Scholasticism.
Benedict's Rule through Aquinas's Summa through Dante's Comedy — the Latin Catholic spine has NO corpus home. 10 orphan docs. Civilizational weight demands its own wedge.
Recognized sub-canon since Cotelier 1672 (Lightfoot, Ehrman Loeb). Shepherd of Hermas + Barnabas in Codex Sinaiticus, 1 Clement in Alexandrinus — near-canonical. 9 orphan docs ready.

Distinct Aramaic-script Eastern Christianity. Diatessaron + Ephrem + Peshitta currently scattered across bible/canonical-translations and ethiopic-tewahedo. Live tradition (Syriac Orthodox, Maronite, Assyrian Church of the East).

Plotinus + Iamblichus + Proclus + Chaldean Oracles are completely unassigned. Dominant philosophical theology of late antiquity, scaffolding for Pseudo-Dionysius / Eckhart / Ficino / Blavatsky. Chaldean Oracles currently mis-classified under greek-scripture philosophical theology.

Largest Hindu denomination (~640M). 9 vault docs (Bhagavata Purana, Ramanuja, Madhva, Tulsidas, Mirabai, Chaitanya Charitamrita) currently scattered into generic vedas corpus. Bhakti spine collapse is hiding the avatar doctrine.
Kashmir Shaivism Trika/Krama/Kaula is a distinct revealed canon (28 Agamas) — Sanderson 1988 treats as separate from Vedanta. 4 vault docs ready.

Shankara's strict non-dual canon (Smarta mainstream Hinduism via dasanami sannyasin order). Currently scattered across vedas/vedanta-exegesis. Distinct from Ramanuja (qualified-nondual) and Madhva (dualism).
Dogen's Shobogenzo is foundational Soto Zen scripture, currently orphaned. Largest Zen denomination (~7,000 Japanese temples) and most influential Buddhist tradition in modern West.
Current 'shia-corpus' is Twelver-only. Rasail Ikhwan al-Safa (52 Fatimid-era epistles) and Jabirian corpus carry explicit Ismaili YAML and are unassigned. Distinct Shia branch with esoteric canon.
Suhrawardi's Hikmat al-Ishraq founded a distinct Islamic philosophical school still taught at Iranian Shia seminaries. Explicit Ishraqi YAML, unassigned.
Mulla Sadra's Asfar — arguably the most influential post-classical Islamic philosophical work, defines Iranian seminary Islam. Currently in NO corpus.
Tafsir is a distinct canonical genre alongside Qur'an and Hadith. Al-Tabari's Jami al-Bayan is the mother-of-all-tafsir. Unassigned.
Theology of Aristotle is the foundational Plotinian substrate of all Islamic philosophy (Avicenna read it 40 times). Ibn Tufayl's Hayy ibn Yaqdhan influenced Spinoza/Locke/Defoe. Both unassigned.
Shah Wali Allah's Hujjat Allah al-Baligha founds Deobandi reform (~150M adherents). Unassigned.
Qutb's Milestones is THE foundational text of revolutionary Islamism. Explicit YAML, unassigned. Distinct 20th-c. sacred-textual tradition.
Odu Ifa is UNESCO-declared Masterpiece of Oral Heritage 2005, anchor scripture of Yoruba + diasporic offshoots. Unassigned.
Caribbean syncretic sacred-textual tradition with Yoruba + Fon-Ewe + Kongo + Catholic strata. 2 orphan docs. Distinct from Yoruba (creole canon).
Huarochiri Manuscript is the 'Popol Vuh of the Andes' — most important surviving indigenous-language record of pre-Columbian Andean religion. Orphan. Structurally distinct from Mesoamerican.
Split from mesoamerican-sacred. Popol Vuh + Chilam Balam + Dresden Codex are distinct from Aztec — different language, religion, polity. Chilam Balam currently orphan.
Split from mesoamerican-sacred. Florentine Codex + Historia de los Mexicanos + Codex Borgia. Different religion from Maya.
Kumulipo + Maori cosmogonic chants share whakapapa genealogical-recitation form. MASSIVE-WIN: Te Kore (void) ↔ Ginnungagap ↔ Nun ↔ tad ekam.
5 orphan docs (Navajo Blessingway, Black Elk Speaks, Sacred Pipe, Gayanashagowa, Walam Olum). Walam Olum included with documented-fabrication framing per deviant-bridge tiering.
Arguably oldest continuous sacred-textual tradition on Earth (60,000+ years). Tjukurpa/Altyerre. Orphan. Song-line + ritual-performance + iconography integrated.
Blavatsky Isis Unveiled + Secret Doctrine + Atlantis Root Race + Outline of Esoteric Science all unassigned. Seed of Anthroposophy, Arcane School, I AM, New Age.
Liber AL vel Legis is founding revealed scripture of Thelema/OTO/A∴A∴. Both Liber AL and Magick in Theory and Practice unassigned despite explicit Thelema YAML.
Gardner's Witchcraft Today is founding public scripture of modern Pagan revival (largest in tradition, ~75 yrs). Unassigned.
Hubbard's Dianetics is founding scripture of federally-recognized religion. Explicit Scientology YAML, unassigned.
LaVey's Satanic Bible founds Church of Satan canon. Explicit YAML, unassigned.
Apuleius Bk 11 + PGM unassigned. Bacchae + Oresteia + Orphica currently mixed into greek-scripture's Homer-Hesiod civic-poetry wedge. Burkert canonical distinction between mystery and civic.

Eddy's Science and Health + Kybalion + Course in Miracles form American metaphysical-religion strand. Kybalion currently mis-filed in hermetica — it's New Thought claiming Hermetic vocabulary, not Hermetic transmission.
Boehme + Vaughan + Swedenborg — distinct esoteric-Christian tradition seeded Anthroposophy + Blake + Romantic theology. 3-4 orphan docs.
Apocryphal Acts + martyr-acts + Letter to Flora (Schneemelcher canon) — neither NT-canonical nor Nag Hammadi-Gnostic. 3 orphan docs.
Devi Mahatmya is the 'Gita of the Goddess' — foundational Shakta text (~30M adherents). Currently in vedas/purana but Shakta theology (Goddess as Brahman) is irreducible.
Kabir Panth Bijak — sociologically + theologically distinct from saguna Vaishnava bhakti. Critically: Adi Granth incorporates ~270 Kabir hymns, making Sant corpus the seed of Sikhism. Orphan.
Engishiki (927 CE) is the third pillar of Shinto canonical lit alongside Kojiki/Nihongi — 27 norito are actual liturgical scripture recited at shrines today. Orphan stub.
547 birth-stories — largest source of Buddhist art motifs across SE Asia. Currently orphan stub.

medium_priority_adds.rationale: Marcion's Evangelion + Apostolikon is the FIRST Christian closed canon (~140 CE) — provoked proto-orthodox canon-formation. Reconstructible from Tertullian Adv. Marc. + Epiphanius Pan. 42 (Harnack 1924, BeDuhn 2013, Roth 2015). NO vault doc represents it directly. John's criterion that suppressed canons qualify means this is a real corpus gap awaiting Lane A content.

reclassifications.reason: Canaanite religion is West Semitic, NOT Mesopotamian. Mis-classification under mesopotamian conflates the Akkadian-Babylonian East with the Ugaritic-Levantine West. Smith's Ugaritic Baal Cycle treats this as a distinct corpus.
Same West-Semitic vs. Mesopotamian misclassification as Baal Cycle. KTU 1.40-1.176 ritual tablets are the priestly counterpart of the Baal Cycle.

Chaldean Oracles are Neoplatonist revealed theurgic scripture (Lewy, Majercik), not Plato-Aristotle philosophical theology. Mis-classification flattens a distinct mystical-revealed canon into civic philosophy.

Kybalion is New Thought metaphysical idealism using Hermetic vocabulary as window-dressing — NOT actual Hermetic transmission. Per Albanese's Republic of Mind and Spirit, this is American metaphysical religion, not Hermetic lineage.
Bacchae is Dionysian-mystery theology in dramatic form — Burkert distinguishes mystery cults from Olympian civic religion. Currently mixed with Homer/Hesiod public civic poetry.
Orphica should anchor a dedicated mystery-cult corpus alongside Eleusinian/Isis/Mithraic material rather than sitting as a sub-wedge under greek-scripture.
Same as Orphic tablets — Derveni papyrus is Orphic-mystery exegesis.

duplicates_or_already_covered: Apostolic Fathers includes phase-4-095-new-testament-canon — verify this isn't already in bible/canonical-formation corpus before adding (likely needs to stay in bible corpus, NOT moved to apostolic-fathers).

Christian Theosophy doc phase-7-004-science-and-health appears in BOTH christian-theosophy goblin proposal AND new-thought-corpus goblin proposal. Decision needed: New Thought is the better home (Eddy is the canonical Christian Science / New Thought founder; Swedenborg-Boehme line is upstream influence but not Christian Science proper). Recommend Science and Health -> new-thought-corpus only; christian-theosophy gets Boehme + Vaughan + Swedenborg.

Mashafa Kidan and Ethiopian Sinodos (proposed under syriac-christianity) are already in ethiopic-tewahedo-canon — keep them there; don't move to Syriac. Goblin overreached by claiming these as Syriac.

Pseudo-Dionysius (phase-4-030) and Celestial Hierarchy + Eriugena + Theology of Aristotle-Arabic appear in BOTH neoplatonist-corpus AND byzantine-orthodox / arabic-neoplatonism goblin proposals. Decision: Pseudo-Dionysius and Eriugena are downstream Christian Neoplatonism — primary home is byzantine-orthodox / latin-catholic; can also tag-link to neoplatonist-corpus as bridge but don't double-assign as primary. Theology of Aristotle-Arabic stays in arabic-neoplatonism.
Codex Borgia listed under aztec-mexica-corpus by Indigenous goblin — already partially in mesoamerican-sacred; verify split is clean.

Hatha Yoga Pradipika (phase-5-035) listed under shaiva-tantric-canon — actually a Natha-yogic text that some scholars place in its own Hatha lineage; acceptable as Shaiva-adjacent but flag for review.

Phase-5-008-eriugena-periphyseon appears under BOTH byzantine-orthodox AND neoplatonist-corpus goblin proposals — Eriugena is Latin Catholic-trained translating Greek Dionysian material, so latin-catholic-medieval may be the better primary home with byzantine-orthodox + neoplatonist-corpus as secondary cross-links.
